definition: A reproducible architecture, workload, RTL-slice, formal-safety, synthesis, power, thermal and evidence workflow using only open-source technology.
complete_when: Architecture arithmetic and decision gates are versioned and executable
Deterministic workload campaigns emit bandwidth, latency, queue and refresh metrics
A 16-channel controller composition parses and synthesizes in open-source tooling
Bounded safety properties cover refresh priority and controller progress
Power, thermal, reliability and physical proxies are tied to the same configuration
Every result states its evidence class and limitations
The product exports a reproducible evidence snapshot
external_silicon_gates: Measured bandwidth, energy, thermal, repair and reliability
Calibration of all analytical and physical models against silicon
policy: External silicon gates must remain unverified until real artifacts are ingested.
